plugins.name: GenieACS Manager
plugins.description: Kelola ONT/ONU lewat GenieACS (TR-069): WiFi, WAN, monitoring perangkat, dan banyak server sekaligus.
plugins.description_en: Manage ONT/ONU devices through GenieACS (TR-069): WiFi, WAN, device monitoring and multiple servers.

plugins.name: MIKROMON
plugins.description: Monitor MikroTik real-time: trafik PPPoE, bandwidth, CPU, memori, riwayat pemakaian, remote access, dan port forwarding.
plugins.description_en: Real-time MikroTik monitoring: PPPoE traffic, bandwidth, CPU, memory, usage history, remote access and port forwarding.

plugins.name: Mapping FTTH
plugins.description: Peta jaringan FTTH interaktif: OLT, ODC, ODP, tiang, kabel, pelanggan, dan survei homepass di atas peta.
plugins.description_en: Interactive FTTH network map: OLT, ODC, ODP, poles, cables, customers and homepass survey on the map.

plugins.name: QuickHotspot
plugins.description: Voucher hotspot MikroTik tanpa registrasi pelanggan: buat, kelola, dan jual voucher, lengkap dengan beli mandiri lewat payment gateway dan sistem reseller.
plugins.description_en: MikroTik hotspot vouchers without customer registration: generate, manage and sell vouchers, with self-service payment gateway purchase and reseller system.
